source: Official 2025 counselling documents where reachable: JAC Delhi 2025 Round 5 category cutoff PDFs (DTU, NSUT; Outside Delhi GNGNO column, JEE Main CRL); Maharashtra State CET Cell 'Cut Off List for All India Seats, CAP Round IV, A.Y. 2025-26' (JEE Main percentiles converted to CRL with N = 14,75,103 unique JEE Main 2025 candidates per NTA's 19 Apr 2025 result notice); HSTES Haryana 'Last Year's Opening and Closing Rank Cut-offs' (2025 data on the 2026-27 portal, AIC = All India Category, counselling 2); OJEE 'Opening & Closing Ranks - BTech 2025' PDF (JEE Main CRL, Home State rows for government colleges). UP (HBTU, IET Lucknow, MMMUT, KNIT) and MP (SGSITS) figures come from Careers360/CollegeDekho reproductions of 2025 counselling because the official admissions.nic.in OR-CR reports were unreachable from this environment. Jadavpur (WBJEE) from Cracku/Collegedunia. Rajasthan REAP, MP DTE (MITS, JEC, UIT-RGPV) and Bihar UGEAC were not included: no official 2025 JEE-Main-CRL closing data was obtainable (REAP and UGEAC publish state merit ranks, and the mirrors disagree). IGDTUW skipped (women-only).

entries.college: Jadavpur University, Kolkata
entries.quota: Home State / common merit (JU has no separate other-state quota)
entries.note: Exam is WBJEE (General Merit Rank), not JEE Main. Closing GMR 238 (Open, Round 2) per Cracku and Collegedunia mirrors; another outlet (Outlook) reported 120 for Round 2, so the figure is uncertain. JEE-Main-CRL equivalent is a rough heuristic: GMR 238 is the top ~0.2% of ~1.3 lakh WBJEE takers, a pool dominated by JEE aspirants; JU CSE admits typically hold ~99.2-99.5 JEE Main percentile, i.e. CRL ~7,000-12,000; midpoint ~10,000 used.
